craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-adbhuta of rested-emitted — peace inside wonder; rest-and-publish song. Entered-stilled; expanse-wonders-to-see (wonder seeing itself). Rejected: (a) wonders→marvels → killed: wonder is the term. Read aloud: OF the-TWO … BLESS-ed OWN-know-ing's EX-panse WON-ders TO-see.

lines: Of the two — entered, states sequenced, thoughts stilled —
blessed own-knowing's expanse wonders to see.
